listings.name: South African Business Council UAE (SABCO)
listings.description: The official South African business council in the UAE. Regular networking events, inter-council nights, braai days and business workshops. 800+ SA-connected members.

listings.name: South African Consulate General — Dubai
listings.description: Official South African Consulate General serving UAE residents. Passport renewal, birth registration, marriages, apostilles and emergency travel documents. Book appointments online.

listings.name: Mozambik — Dubai Marina
listings.description: South African flame-grilled restaurant chain bringing piri-piri chicken and SA braai culture to Dubai Marina. Family-friendly, with a lively outdoor terrace.

listings.name: Mozambik — JBR The Walk
listings.area: JBR The Walk, Jumeirah Beach Residence
listings.description: Mozambik's beach-side location at JBR. Piri-piri chicken, ribs, grills and SA comfort food steps from the beach. Great for a Saffa gathering.

listings.name: Braai Republic — Dubai
listings.description: South African braai restaurant serving traditional SA meats, boerewors, sosaties and sides. Authentically South African menu, popular with the SA community.

listings.name: SPAR — Dubai (SA Grocery)
listings.description: SPAR stores in Dubai carry selected South African products including Simba chips, Mrs Ball's chutney, Knorrox spices, Ouma rusks and more. Check the SA foods aisle.

listings.name: South African School Dubai (SASD)
listings.description: CAPS curriculum school for South African children in Dubai. Follows the South African National Curriculum Assessment Policy Statement. Suitable for families relocating temporarily or long-term.

listings.name: Stormers Rugby Bar
listings.description: Popular SA sports bar showing SuperRugby, Springboks matches and SA Premier Soccer League games. Community favourite for big match days.

listings.name: deVere Group — SA Expat Specialists
listings.description: International financial advisory firm with advisors specialising in South African expat financial planning — SARS compliance, financial emigration, offshore investment structures and retirement planning from UAE.

listings.name: Creative Zone — UAE Visa & Business Setup
listings.description: Business and visa setup consultants popular with SA entrepreneurs in UAE. Company formation, freelance visas, golden visas, UAE residency and PRO services.

listings.name: Life Church Dubai
listings.description: Multi-cultural church with a strong South African congregation. English-language services. Welcomes newcomers from SA and runs community integration activities.

listings.name: Dubai Chambers — International Business
listings.description: Dubai Chamber of Commerce reported 873 active South African member companies as of March 2026. Register your SA-owned business and access government tenders and networking.

listings.name: Mediclinic — Recommended for SA Patients
listings.description: Mediclinic is the leading private hospital group in Dubai (and SA). Medical reports produced here are accepted by the SA Consulate and SARS without apostille for most purposes.

listings.name: Springbok Movers — SA International Removals
listings.description: SA-run international removals company specialising in Dubai ↔ South Africa moves. Door-to-door shipping, customs clearing, vehicle transport and temporary storage.

listings.name: SA Photographers Network — UAE
listings.description: Network of South African photographers based in the UAE. Covers weddings, corporate events, family portraits and commercial shoots. Enquire via WhatsApp Business.

listings.name: Talent Bridge
listings.description: South African-led executive search, recruitment and headhunting agency operating across the UAE. Specialists in placing SA professionals and helping UAE employers find top SA talent. Also offers psychometric assessments and candidate evaluation.

listings.name: iMPLEMENTAi.ae
listings.description: AI implementation and business automation consultancy helping UAE businesses reduce manual work, automate enquiry handling, WhatsApp follow-up and sales pipelines, and deploy AI tools and CRM systems. Founded by South Africans.
